overview.overview:
Montana is expected to vote Republican in 2028. The state backed the Republican presidential candidate by 16.4 points in 2020 and by 19.9 points in 2024, and it leans about 19 points more Republican than the nation as a whole. The central expectation is a Republican margin of roughly 14 to 15 points, with a plausible range that stays firmly in Republican territory.

No polls or home-state candidates are currently on record for the contest. The 2026 Senate figures for Montana also show a wide statewide margin in the same Republican-leaning direction. Montana's four electoral votes are very unlikely to decide the national outcome.
overview.watch: A sustained shift in national polling or a major change in the Republican-leaning statewide electorate would be needed to narrow the expected margin here.
key_factors: Montana voted Republican by wide margins in both 2020 and 2024.
The state leans about 19 points more Republican than the nation.
The 2026 statewide Senate result points to a similarly wide margin.
No public polling or home-state candidates are currently available.
